_comment: Per-dataset column mapping (raw CSV column -> canonical field). Column names for 3 of these 4 datasets are BEST GUESSES based on common Kaggle exercise-dataset conventions - none have been downloaded/inspected yet (no Kaggle token configured as of writing this). `columnsVerified: false` means: before running ingest_exercise_catalog.py for real, run `python inspect_columns.py <file.csv>` on the actual downloaded file and fix `rawColumns` below to match. The pipeline SKIPS any source whose file isn't present in ml/training/datasets/, so partial ingestion (some sources not downloaded yet) still works.

fitness_exercises_dataset._note: This one mirrors the public ExerciseDB API, whose field names are well-documented (name, bodyPart, target, equipment, gifUrl, secondaryMuscles) - higher confidence than the other three, but still worth a quick inspect_columns.py check since the Kaggle CSV export could differ from the live API's JSON shape.
